jurisdiction: Spain manufacturing activity with official Eurostat STS outcome and public institutional-logistics observers
scientific_question: Do causally available port-flow and procurement-event layers add local one-month-ahead information beyond the own history of a manufacturing production series?

coral_graph.outcome_node: Eurostat sts_inpr_m PRD, NACE C or preregistered manufacturing division, SCA I21, Spain
observer_nodes: Puertos del Estado monthly tonnes by port and non-energy industrial nature
TED daily published award-notice counts by physical-supply CPV and Spanish NUTS
forbidden_edges: consumer or administered price as truth anchor
post-outcome publication entering a prior cutoff
one observer recalibrating another jurisdiction's outcome

schema_probe_exclusion: All probe payloads dated in the public-expansion V1 manifest are schema evidence only and cannot score or fit this campaign.
temporal_rule: Each calendar month predicts exactly the next month. Event data may be aggregated only within its own completed month before the cutoff; multiple months cannot be pooled into one target.

model_cells.M0: local persistence or seasonal-naive baseline selected before target
model_cells.M2_port: M1 plus lagged port-by-nature physical-flow features available at cutoff
model_cells.M2_ted: M1 plus lagged TED CPV-NUTS event counts available at cutoff
model_cells.M3_coral: M1 plus both observer families with separately regularized blocks and no raw-likelihood pooling

support_gates.ted_quantity_and_contract_value_not_requ: TED enters only as event count under current evidence

comparisons: M1 versus M0 within the same outcome cell
M2_port versus M1 within the same outcome cell
M2_ted versus M1 within the same outcome cell
M3_coral versus its preregistered nested parents within the same outcome cell
